title: Performance floor awareness
summary: Aim training often raises the player's performance floor and confidence gradually, even when the change is too subtle to feel immediately from day to day.
cues: Track consistency and worst-case performance, not just peak moments
Expect subtle gains after the beginner phase
Use logs and repeated comparisons when the change is hard to feel
failureModes: Quitting because the improvement stopped feeling dramatic
Assuming no instant sensation means no real gain
